description: Hooten and Alex cross the Amazon, Rome, Egypt, Bhutan, Ethiopia, Moscow, Cambodia and the Caribbean in a chain of artifact hunts that gradually turns their reluctant partnership into mutual trust.

s01e01.description: Museum curator Alex searches the Amazon for Percy Fawcett’s lost camp and is forced to work with Hooten, leading them toward El Dorado while rival explorers close in.

s01e02.description: In Rome, Alex helps Hooten hunt for the lost Sibylline Books, a search that drags them through the Sistine Chapel, an alligator encounter and conflict with the mafia.

s01e03.description: Alex and Hooten search Egypt for the lost tomb of Alexander the Great while local rivals pursue the same prize and repeatedly threaten to reach it first.

s01e04.description: The pair travel into Bhutan’s remote mountains seeking an ancient scroll said to have been written by the Buddha, where isolation makes every setback harder to escape.

s01e05.description: When Ella is kidnapped in Ethiopia, Alex and Hooten abandon artifact hunting for a rescue mission involving armed bandits, difficult terrain and distinctly uncooperative camels.

s01e06.description: Alex joins Hooten in Moscow to locate a missing Fabergé egg and finds herself competing with a former university rival now working for a black-market collector.

s01e07.description: Their search for the legendary Cintamani jewel takes Alex and Hooten into Cambodia, where a ruthless drug gang becomes far more interested in them than either would prefer.

s01e08.description: Alex joins Hooten in the Caribbean to hunt for Captain Henry Morgan’s buried treasure, turning the final expedition into a full-scale pirate mystery.
